title: Kolhan University FYUGP (NEP) Official Paper Marking & Passing Scheme
verifiedFrom: 125,220 real student marksheets across Batches 2022-2024 (Semesters 1 to 7)
passingRule: 40% minimum passing marks in each applicable component (Theory, Internal, Practical) and in Total.

75_THEORY_ONLY.label: MDC / SEC Paper (75 Marks, Theory Only)

50_THEORY_ONLY.label: AEC / VAC Paper (50 Marks, Theory Only)

AEC.note: All Ability Enhancement Courses (Sem 1-4) are 50 marks Theory only (Pass: 20). No Internal, no Practical.

VAC.note: All Value Added Courses (Sem 1 VAC-IA/IB & Sem 4 VAC-II) are 50 marks Theory only (Pass: 20). No Internal, no Practical.

MDC.note: All Multi Disciplinary Courses (Sem 1-3) are 75 marks Theory only (Pass: 30). No Internal, no Practical.

SEC.note: All Skill Enhancement Courses (Sem 1-3) are 75 marks Theory only (Pass: 30). No Internal, no Practical.

IAP.note: Sem 5 Internship / Project Work (IAP) is 100 marks (75 External/Theory + 25 Internal, Pass: 40). No Practical column.

Major_and_Minor.note: Always 100 marks (Pass: 40). Uses 100_PRACTICAL (60+15+25) or 100_NON_PRACTICAL (75+25) based on subject lists and exceptions below.
